purpose: Separate language conditioning from scene differences in the six already-explored states
prompts: pick up the salad dressing and place it in the basket
validity: All three BDDL object sets explicitly contain salad_dressing_1; assert before evaluation. The alternative goal is physically meaningful, but closed-loop competence is not yet validated.
common_noise: 61000 + task*100 + initial + noise_id*100000, same for both prompts and all textures
action_subset: first five execution actions, translation coordinates
comparisons: All state/noise pairs and both random controls; no case or texture selection
exploratory_screen: Median MR language-texture interaction exceeds each random by 1.25x and MR state medians exceed both controls on at least 5/6 states
